title: Prepositions (B2): 随着, 自从, 对…而言, 而已, 凭, 趁, 至于, 包括…在内, 跟…有关
description: Along with, ever since, as far as … is concerned, that's all, on the strength of, while (the chance lasts), as for, including, and related to.

points.title: 随着 …: along with, as
points.summary: 随着 (suízhe) + change (…的发展 / 增长), main clause = as … changes, ….
points.body: - **随着**经济的发展，人们的生活越来越好.
examples: {随着|suízhe}{经济|jīngjì}{的|de}{发展|fāzhǎn}，{人们|rénmen}{的|de}{生活|shēnghuó}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{好|hǎo}。
As the economy develops, people's lives keep getting better.

points.title: 自从 … (以后 / 以来): ever since
points.summary: 自从 (zìcóng) + past event (+ 以后) = ever since ….
points.body: - **自从**他来了以后，办公室热闹多了.
examples: {自从|zìcóng}{搬家|bānjiā}{以后|yǐhòu}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{见|jiàn}{到|dào}{他|tā}{了|le}。
Since I moved, I've rarely seen him.

points.title: 对 … 而言: as far as … is concerned
points.summary: 对 X 而言 (ér yán) = formal 对 X 来说.
examples: {对|duì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{外国人|wàiguó rén}{而言|ér yán}，{声调|shēngdiào}{是|shì}{最|zuì}{难|nán}{的|de}。
For many foreigners, tones are the hardest part.

points.title: … 而已: that's all, merely
points.summary: 而已 (éryǐ) at the end = just, only (often with 只是 / 不过).
examples: He's only a child, that's all.

points.title: 凭: on the strength of, by
points.summary: 凭 (píng) + ability / document = relying on; 凭票入场 = admission by ticket.
points.body: - 他**凭**自己的努力考上了大学.
examples: {他|tā}{凭|píng}{自己|zìjǐ}{的|de}{努力|nǔlì}{考|kǎo}{上|shàng}{了|le}{大学|dàxué}。
He got into university through his own hard work.

points.title: 趁: while, taking the chance
points.summary: 趁 (chèn) + situation = while it lasts / take advantage of ….
points.body:
- **趁**年轻，多出去走走吧.
- 菜**趁**热吃吧.

points.title: 至于: as for
points.summary: 至于 (zhìyú) + related topic = 'as for …' (switches to a new, related point).
points.body: - 我们先把工作做完，**至于**怎么庆祝，以后再说.
examples: As for how to celebrate, we'll talk about it later.

points.title: 包括 … 在内: including
points.summary: (包括) X 在内 (zài nèi) = X included.
examples: {包括|bāokuò}{老师|lǎoshī}{在内|zài nèi}，{大家|dàjiā}{都|dōu}{同意|tóngyì}{了|le}。

points.title: 跟 / 和 … 有关(的): related to
points.summary: 跟 X 有关 (yǒuguān) = related to X; 跟 X 有关的 + noun.
points.body: - 我想找一些**跟**中国历史**有关的**书.
examples: This is a problem related to the environment.

questions.prompt: （　）{经济|jīngjì}{的|de}{发展|fāzhǎn}，{人们|rénmen}{的|de}{生活|shēnghuó}{越来越|yuè lái yuè}{好|hǎo}。
questions.translation: As the economy develops, people's lives keep getting better.

options: {随着|suízhe}{时间|shíjiān}{的|de}{过去|guòqù}，{他|tā}{慢慢|mànmàn}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
{随着|suízhe}{时间|shíjiān}{的|de}{过去|guòqù}{他|tā}，{慢慢|mànmàn}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
{随着|suízhe}{时间|shíjiān}{过去|guòqù}{的|de}，{他|tā}{慢慢|mànmàn}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
{时间|shíjiān}{随着|suízhe}{的|de}{过去|guòqù}，{他|tā}{慢慢|mànmàn}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
notes: The subject belongs to the main clause.
的 goes before the change: 时间的过去.
questions.translation: As time went by, he slowly forgot about it.

questions.prompt: （　）{他|tā}{来|lái}{了|le}{以后|yǐhòu}，{办公室|bàngōngshì}{热闹|rènao}{多|duō}{了|le}。
notes: 从此 = 'from then on' — stands alone, not before a clause.
questions.translation: Ever since he arrived, the office has been much livelier.

questions.prompt: What does 「{自从|zìcóng}{搬家|bānjiā}{以后|yǐhòu}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{见|jiàn}{到|dào}{他|tā}{了|le}。」 mean?
notes: 自从 refers to the past.

questions.explanation: As far as … is concerned: **对…而言**.
questions.translation: For me, health matters more than money.

questions.prompt: {对|duì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{外国人|wàiguó rén}（　），{声调|shēngdiào}{是|shì}{最|zuì}{难|nán}{的|de}。
questions.translation: For many foreigners, tones are the hardest part.

notes: 而言 needs 对 … before it.
questions.translation: Relax, I'm just asking, that's all.

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{不过|búguò}{是|shì}{个|ge}{孩子|háizi}{而已|éryǐ}。」 mean?
notes: 而已 doesn't add a contrast.

questions.translation: He got into university through his own hard work.

questions.prompt: What does the sign 「{凭|píng}{票|piào}{入场|rùchǎng}」 mean?
notes: 凭票 = by showing a ticket.
当年轻 would need 的时候.

questions.translation: Eat it while it's hot — it's not good cold.

questions.prompt: {我们|wǒmen}{先|xiān}{把|bǎ}{工作|gōngzuò}{做|zuò}{完|wán}，（　）{怎么|zěnme}{庆祝|qìngzhù}，{以后|yǐhòu}{再|zài}{说|shuō}。
notes: 随着 = 'along with (a change)' — it doesn't introduce a topic.
questions.translation: Let's finish the work first — as for how to celebrate, we'll talk about it later.

questions.prompt: Which word introduces a new, related topic ('as for …')?

questions.translation: Including me, there are ten people in total.

questions.prompt: What does 「{包括|bāokuò}{老师|lǎoshī}{在内|zài nèi}，{大家|dàjiā}{都|dōu}{同意|tóngyì}{了|le}。」 mean?
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{找|zhǎo}{一些|yìxiē}{跟|gēn}{中国|Zhōngguó}{历史|lìshǐ}（　）{的|de}{书|shū}。
notes: 关于 goes before the topic, not after it.
关系 is a noun (跟…有关系).
对于 goes before the topic.
questions.translation: I'm looking for some books about Chinese history.

notes: 跟 needs the topic right after it.
questions.translation: This is a problem related to the environment.
